payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics and results achieved by the proposed model using ELMo embeddings for fine-grained named entity classification.

claims.text: The proposed model achieves a total F-1 score of 88% on the OntoNotes dataset and a micro-averaged F-1 score of 53% on the Wiki(gold) dataset.
The model's performance on other categories in the OntoNotes dataset shows F-1 scores between 80-90%, except for time which has a score of 65%.
The framework is designed to provide acceptable out-of-the-box performance for fine-grained datasets without specific tuning.
